name: vLLM 0.12 on 4x Arc Pro B60 (TP=4): Qwen3-VL-30B peak aggregate throughput (c=64)
methodology: THIRD-PARTY MEASURED (Embedded LLM, Feb 14 2026). Sparkle 4x Intel Arc Pro B60 workstation, TP=4, 24GB/456GB-s per GPU. Qwen/Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct. vLLM 0.12 vs Intel LLM-Scaler 1.2. Concurrency 16/32/64, 1K->1K and 1K->2K scenarios. ~1000 tok/s aggregate at 64 concurrent requests (long-form generation scenario).
notes: Peak aggregate across 64 concurrent requests - server throughput, not per-request decode.
